releases.summary: Fixed the Docker build and GitHub Actions runtime configuration.

changes.description: Corrected the Alpine emoji font package name so Docker images build successfully.
Updated CI and release workflows to use Node.js 24 and removed the Node.js 20 deprecation warning.

releases.summary: Fixed missing fonts in Canvas-generated Discord images.

changes.description: Added fontconfig, DejaVu fonts, and Noto emoji fonts to the Docker image so generated images render Unicode characters and emoji instead of square glyphs.

releases.summary: Removed server-specific Crimson Skies branding from generated command artwork.

changes.description: Replaced hardcoded server branding and asset names with generic Dune Server placeholders.
Clarified that deployment-specific channel IDs belong only in environment configuration.

releases.summary: Organized the source tree and improved blueprint audit logging.

changes.description: Grouped Discord-facing code, infrastructure, reusable modules, and shared helpers into clear source areas.
Blueprint imports now resolve the Console player correctly and use the player pawn ID.
Blueprint audit messages include the uploaded JSON through a Components V2 File component.
